page.notes: The woodcut initial at the start of "Audistis" is an ornamental block; the first letter is likely A, marked [?]. The printed text in the scripture passage reads "Vdistis" in the italic type, so the initial is shown as "Audistis" after u/v normalisation. Probable printing errors left as printed: "quodquicunque" printed without a space (rendered "quod quicunque"); "conijciatur" and "proijce" with i as printed. Running head and page number are as printed. The line-end hyphen in "proxi-" is kept; the catchword "mi" completes the word on the next page.
